entries.title: Proverbs 24:1
segments: ¶Do not be envious of evil men, Nor desire to be with them;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:2
segments: For their heart devises violence, And their lips talk of troublemaking.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:3
segments: ¶Through wisdom a house is built, And by understanding it is established;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:4
segments: By knowledge the rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:5
segments: A wise man [is] strong, Yes, a man of knowledge increases strength;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:6
segments: For by wise counsel you will wage your own war, And in a multitude of counselors [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:7
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] too lofty for a fool; He does not open his mouth in the gate.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:8
segments: He who plots to do evil Will be called a schemer.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:9
segments: The devising of foolishness [is] sin, And the scoffer [is] an abomination to men.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:10
segments: ¶[If] you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength [is] small.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:11
segments: ¶Deliver [those who] are drawn toward death, And hold back [those] stumbling to the slaughter.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:12
segments: If you say, "Surely we did not know this," Does not He who weighs the hearts consider [it]? He who keeps your soul, does He [not] know [it]? And will He [not]  render to [each] man according to his deeds?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:13
segments: ¶My son, eat honey because [it is] good, And the honeycomb [which is] sweet to your taste;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:14
segments: So [shall] the knowledge of wisdom [be] to your soul; If you have found [it], there is a prospect, And your hope will not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:15
segments: ¶Do not lie in wait, O wicked [man], against the dwelling of the righteous; Do not plunder his resting place;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:16
segments: For a righteous [man] may fall seven times And rise again, But the wicked shall fall by calamity.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:17
segments: ¶Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, And do not let your heart be glad when he stumbles;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:18
segments: Lest the LORD see [it], and it displease Him, And He turn away His wrath from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:19
segments: ¶Do not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the wicked;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:20
segments: For there will be no prospect for the evil [man]; The lamp of the wicked will be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:21
segments: ¶My son, fear the LORD and the king; Do not associate with those given to change;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:22
segments: For their calamity will rise suddenly, And who knows the ruin those two can bring?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:23
segments: ¶These [things] also [belong] to the wise: [It is] not good to show partiality in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:24
segments: He who says to the wicked, "You [are] righteous," Him the people will curse; Nations will abhor him.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:25
segments: But those who rebuke [the wicked] will have delight, And a good blessing will come upon them.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:26
segments: He who gives a right answer kisses the lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:27
segments: ¶Prepare your outside work, Make it fit for yourself in the field; And afterward build your house.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:28
segments: ¶Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, For would you deceive with your lips?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:29
segments: Do not say, "I will do to him just as he has done to me; I will render to the man according to his work."

entries.title: Proverbs 24:30
segments: ¶I went by the field of the lazy [man], And by the vineyard of the man devoid of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:31
segments: And there it was, all overgrown with thorns; Its surface was covered with nettles; Its stone wall was broken down.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:32
segments: When I saw [it], I considered [it] well; I looked on [it and] received instruction:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:33
segments: A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:34
segments: So shall your poverty come [like] a prowler, And your need like an armed man.
